name: Running The Race
overview: Scripture portrays the Christian life as a race that requires endurance, focus, and reliance on the Lord’s strength. Isaiah 40:31 encourages believers to wait on the Lord to renew their strength so they can run without growing weary, while Matthew 24:13 emphasizes the necessity of enduring to the end for salvation. Paul’s example in Acts 20:24 highlights the joy found in finishing the course God has set, and his words in Philippians 3:13-14 show the importance of pressing forward, forgetting past failures, and striving toward the heavenly calling. Galatians 5:7 warns against anything that hinders obedience and causes one to fall back in this race of faith.
